results.comparison: 分別以完整模型total與每token active參數代理匹配Dense，width取最近4倍數。相同資料/token/更新預算；active參數不是精確FLOPs，路由與索引成本另看實測時間。
results.auxiliary_note: 輔助loss每層相加，只含有效輸入token；路由統計分母為token×top_k，PAD排除。
results.limitations: 單一seed；不同width的Dense改變表徵容量，dropless Python dispatch不保證加速。

hf.checkpoint_resume_scope: Backup includes the full experiment directory. Optimizer/RNG resume support depends on each checkpoint format and training entrypoint; a backup alone is not an exact-resume guarantee. Public inference exports remove optimizer/RNG state.
